final: SELECT acctscope, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * order_count / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope)
